'''The Howling Vale''' {{co|52|37|Ashenvale}} is a cave located in north-central [[Ashenvale]], just southwest of the border to [[Felwood]]. The vale is home to a tribe of [[worgen]] called the [[Terrowulf]], and they have completely overtaken the ruined Shrine of Mel'Thandris located there. It is the worgen's chilling calls that have given the vale its new name. [[Alliance]] adventurers come here from time to time in search of the legacy of the famed sentinel [[Velinde Starsong]].
